english:
Breaking a Combatant's Shield for the first time spawns an Orb of Power that grants 7.15% Super Energy.

Performing a Finisher on a Combatant that did not trigger this effect also spawns an Orb of Power.

Only works once per enemy.

source.text:
Upon first breaking a Combatant Shield:

Creates an Orb of Power that grants 7.15% Super Energy.
Performing a Finisher on a Combatant that didn't trigger the effect will also spawn an Orb of Power.

Only works once per enemy.
